summary: Build practical livelihood recovery plans, market restoration tools, and reporting skills in 5 days. Reserve your place today.
lede: Post-disaster livelihood restoration involves assessing income and asset losses, then planning support that helps households and markets recover. For recovery coordinators, livelihoods and economic development professionals, and humanitarian program managers, the course covers rapid needs and market analysis, prioritizing assistance within budget limits, sequencing interventions, and tracking results with indicators and digital tools.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to restore livelihoods after disaster and connect recovery actions to economic development outcomes.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of disaster management, community recovery, or development programming, plus practical experience in project coordination, assessment, or field implementation. Familiarity with basic monitoring and evaluation concepts is helpful. No coding or programming is required, although prior exposure to Excel-based analysis, survey tools, or GIS reporting will make the exercises easier to apply.
